summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing for ColabRise landing page. All 11 listed test cases passed. Backend pytest suite (5/5) covering root welcome, lead create (happy path, invalid email, missing name), and sorted list — all green. Frontend Playwright run validated hero heading, hero/navbar CTAs scroll to #book-a-call, complete lead form submission (POST /api/leads returned 201 and UI swapped to lead-form-success), FAQ accordion expand/collapse, and all three pricing tier CTAs present and clickable. Zero console errors on landing page load.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailStr in pydantic rejects reserved TLDs like '.test' / '.example' — fine for prod since users send real emails, but worth knowing for any future seeding/QA scripts.

create_lead serialises datetime to ISO string before insert and list_leads parses it back — works but mixing native datetimes vs ISO strings in Mongo can drift; consider storing as native BSON Date for indexable sort.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads — public lead form is spam-able. Consider basic IP throttling or hCaptcha before launch.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. Lock down origins in prod env.

Pricing tier label 'Empire' is rendered via CSS uppercase from source token 'EMPIRE' (text match was case-sensitive miss in test, not a bug); all three CTAs (Start with Ignite / Go Pro / Talk to founders) confirmed visible & clickable.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_-prefixed lead documents in MongoDB via API during tests. Not cleaned up — easily filterable by 'TEST_' name prefix or email containing test_ if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_colabrise.py is the regression suite (5 tests, all green). EmailStr blocks reserved TLDs (.test/.example.* etc) — use example.com/.co for valid test emails. Lead POST returns 201 with id+created_at ISO; list returns desc-sorted. Frontend success state selector is data-testid='lead-form-success'. Budget chip testids are 'lead-budget-<exact label>' e.g. 'lead-budget-$5k–$15k/mo'.
